recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞體積大、染色質呈細緻開放的篩網狀，中央一個晚期紅血球前驅細胞核有突出的核芽（nuclear budding），左側大型粒細胞前驅細胞也偏大，呈核質發育不同步，符合巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely reticulated chromatin and deep blue cytoplasm
Late erythroid precursor with a dense nucleus and an attached nuclear bud (nuclear budding)
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in precursors with hemoglobinizing cytoplasm
Large granulocytic precursors with coarse granules and open chromatin (left of field)
Background oval macrocytes; image resolution is limited by blur at high magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high magnification shows enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely reticulated chromatin and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm, indicating nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony. A late erythroid precursor in the center shows a dense nucleus with an attached nuclear bud. Large granulocytic precursors with open chromatin are also present, and background red cells include oval macrocytes. Fine nuclear detail is somewhat limited by image blur, but the findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis as seen in megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Nuclear budding also occurs in MDS, but MDS lacks the global megaloblastic change with giant metamyelocytes and shows persistent dysplasia and clonal abnormalities despite normal B12/folate.
CDA shows binucleated erythroblasts and internuclear bridges confined to the erythroid lineage, without megaloblastic granulocytic precursors.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows an immature proerythroblast predominance without the orderly (though asynchronous) maturation seen here.
